svg.text: The reactor runs for days, and regulates itself while it runs
Our rig, our inline photometer, our logged pressure and pH
OD600 0.84 → 3.77 over 102 hours of unbroken logging — 11,493 rows kept of 12,259.
Below pH 6.8 the controller dosed KOH on its own, 53 times overnight, holding pH in a 6.4 – 7.9 sawtooth.
The grey band in the growth curve is ten hours lost to a host-computer update; the second rise at 47 h is loss of selection, not biology.
The pH loop is a real sensor-to-actuator loop, but it ran one night only — 1 M KOH corroded four valves in succession.
